item.title: That much data can't be wrong
item.description: That much data can’t be wrong AI is awesome. I use Claude daily and find it extremely useful. But a recent experience reminded me that like any tool, it still requires skill to use it effectively. I got a message from my coworker letting me know they would be removing a linting rule that requires a certain configuration comment in our code (for my fellow rubyists out there, I’m referring to frozen_string_literal of course).
